name: pascal-bencode-cli
title: Pascal Bencode CLI
blurb: Bencode encode and decode with canonical key ordering

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} a b > /dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd: set +e; ./bin/{{ npm_name }} nope.benc > /dev/null 2>&1; status=$?; echo "exit status: $status"; test "$status" -eq 1

detect.contains: procedure DictSet(d: PBencode; const key: AnsiString; v: PBencode);
